description: This file contains the source code for the 'Promotion' controller class within the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It defines the 'Promotion' class that extends the base controller and manages promotional operations such as fetching promotion data, handling extension downloads, installation, and deletion.

classes.name: Promotion
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling marketplace promotion operations within the OpenCart admin area. It extends the core Controller class and includes methods for viewing, fetching, and managing promotional extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the promotion controller, loads language, manages extension type detection, fetches promotion data (from cache or via API call), processes extensions (download, install, delete), and renders the promotion view.
